issues.issue: Did the PRRA officer err by not holding an oral hearing?
issues.applicant_position: Officer made a veiled credibility finding about the applicant's sexual orientation and did not apply the section 167 IRPR hearing factors.
issues.respondent_position: No duty to hold a hearing; officer only weighed the evidence and made no credibility finding.
issues.result_quote: There was no duty to provide an oral hearing.

issues.issue: Did the officer err by not considering the compelling reasons under subsection 108(4) of the IRPA?
issues.applicant_position: Officer had to consider compelling reasons under subsection 108(4); failing to do so is a reviewable error.
issues.respondent_position: Subsection 108(4) applies only to persons previously found to be refugees; the applicant was never found to be one.
issues.result_quote: The PRRA Officer did not err in his analysis as subsection 108(4) of the IRPA is inapplicable to the Applicant’s situation.
